title: fix(integrate): align default query window with evaluation interval

files.patch:
@@ -99,6 +99,7 @@ jobs:
 - The integration config file must specify data source connections and alert rule templates.
 - The config file must include `folders.conversion_path` and `folders.deployment_path` settings.
 - Data source configurations should include connection details and authentication.
+- When `time_window` is unset in both the configuration and defaults, alert queries look back `5m`, matching the default rule group evaluation interval.
 - Alert rule templates define the structure and default values for generated rules.
 - Labels and annotations can be templated from Sigma rule metadata. Refer to [Alert rule labels and annotations](../../docs/configure/labels-and-annotations.md).

@@ -23,7 +23,7 @@ defaults:
     data_source: grafanacloud-logs # The UID of a data source
     # data_source_type: elasticsearch # The data source plugin type, to select a built-in query model. Defaults to the conversion target
     rule_group: Every 5 Minutes
-    time_window: 5m
+    time_window: 5m # Query window and rule group evaluation interval; defaults to 5m when unset
     folder_id: XXXX
     org_id: 1
     test_queries: true # Whether to test the queries against the datasource

-                    "description": "Time window for alert evaluation",

@@ -64,7 +64,7 @@ These settings control the alert rules the integrate stage builds, and how it te
 | `folder_id`            | string  | None       | UID of the Grafana folder the alert rules go in. Every configuration must resolve a value, here or in `defaults`.                                                                                  |
 | `org_id`               | integer | None       | ID of the Grafana organization. Every configuration must resolve a value, here or in `defaults`.                                                                                                   |
 | `rule_group`           | string  | `Default`  | Name of the alert rule group in Grafana.                                                                                                                                                            |
-| `time_window`          | duration | Refer to the description | How far back each query looks, and how often the rule group is evaluated. Set it explicitly: when it isn't set, queries look back `1m` but the rule group is evaluated every `5m`. |
+| `time_window`          | duration | `5m`       | How far back each query looks, and how often the rule group is evaluated. |
 | `lookback`             | duration | `0s`      | Shifts the query time range back by this amount, to allow for ingestion delay. For example, a `5m` window with a `1m` lookback queries from 6 minutes ago to 1 minute ago.                         |
 | `test_queries`         | boolean | `false`    | Run each query against the data source and report the results on the pull request.                                                                                                                  |
 | `from`                 | string  | `now-1h`   | Start of the query testing time range, for example, `now-24h`.                                                                                                                                       |
